d: Hakeem Jeffries has criticised Donald Trump's Iran war, calling it reckless and costly while demanding an end to the conflict. The Democratic leader said the war has made the United States less safe and claimed Iran is now stronger than before. Jeffries also blamed the conflict for skyrocketing gas, food and diesel prices, as well as rising costs of everyday goods. Declaring that the war must end, Jeffries said, "We're going to end the war in Iran one way or the other." His remarks intensify the political debate over Trump's Iran policy, its economic impact and America's national security.
